engine.note: causes.json changed after the board engine only in timestamp-grid entries

labels.confirmed: independent execution or inspection at the pinned revision supports the assertion for the named stage, configuration and operation
labels.refuted: the named configuration's own path contradicts it for the tested inputs
labels.partially_resolved: decisive for some stages or configurations, mixed or not reached for others
labels.unresolved: no tested configuration reached the stage the assertion is about
labels.overall_rule: the overall label follows the primary configuration when its outcome is decisive; if a secondary configuration reaches a different decisive outcome the overall label is partially_resolved with every per-configuration outcome listed; not_consumed under the primary configuration is reported as 'refuted for that configuration (feature selection)'; not_reached never confirms

evidence_kinds.implementation_execution: the pinned stack's own functions executed on pinned inputs
evidence_kinds.mechanism_control: a deliberately constructed input (e.g. no stats) through the real function; never a dataset result
evidence_kinds.synthetic_shift: labelled synthetic deployment values through the real function; descriptive only
evidence_kinds.provenance: released small files (stats/config/README/license) with hashes; no weights

openpi_fork.deviation: pyav==14.0.1 is no longer on PyPI and is omitted; the VLABench datasets declare total_videos 0 (images embedded)

gr00t.recipe: torch 2.7.1+cpu / torchvision 0.22.1+cpu plus the lock's pins for numpy pandas scipy tqdm pyarrow av opencv-python-headless; gr00t source on sys.path (not installed)
gr00t.deviation: only gr00t.data modules are imported; model code, flash-attn and CUDA wheels are not installed

environments.isolation: every probe runs with python -I, HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 and a private HF_HOME / LeRobot home under /tmp/kinema-normverify/scratch; inputs are private copies, never the Hub cache

checkpoint_selection.rule: Released policies are used only for provenance and inference-loader inputs, selected without looking at their statistics: (1) every VLABench-organisation model whose norm-stats asset id equals the case's fork repo id; (2) the openpi public LIBERO checkpoints for the three upstream LIBERO configs; (3) nvidia/GR00T-N1.6-BEHAVIOR1k, the publisher's BEHAVIOR policy; (4) LeRobot first-party comparators showing LeRobot's inference stats source: lerobot/smolvla_vlabench, lerobot/pi0_libero_finetuned_v044, lerobot/pi05_libero_finetuned_v044. Third-party checkpoints are not used. No weights are downloaded (small files only, <= max_file_bytes).
checkpoint_selection.mapping_rule_vlabench: a checkpoint maps to the pinned fork configs with the same model type (name prefix pi0-, pi0-fast-/pifast-, pi05-), the same repo_id (asset id) and the same '-aligned' flag; if there is none, or the candidates disagree on use_quantile_norm, no normalization is run with it (provenance only)

sampling_rule.rule: data files listed under data/ at the pinned revision: the lexically first file, then files in order of sha256(seed|case_id|path) until `count` distinct files; if the total exceeds byte_cap, drop the last-added files. Every row of every selected file is read for the flagged and control dims; every 25th row is kept at full width.
sampling_rule.control_dim_rule: within the flagged dim's slice [112, 140), the other dim whose stored std is the lower median (ties: lower index)
sampling_rule.scope: a disclosed sample of files; no statement about unsampled rows

synthetic_shift.rule: copies of the first full sampled row with the flagged dim set to stored mean +/- delta, for each absolute delta and for 1x the median stored std of the other dims in the same slice

lerobot_033_policy_rule: policies whose construction needs no pretrained weights or tokenizer downloads and whose defaults normalize STATE and ACTION; ACT's torchvision backbone weights are disabled (config value, not data). pi0/pi0fast/smolvla need Hub VLM/tokenizer downloads; tdmpc uses IDENTITY for STATE; vqbet/sac are not run. make_policy passes ds_meta.stats identically to every policy (source pin lr033.make_policy_stats).
known_limits_before_running: No training and no weights: openpi stats are computed on episode 0 only, through openpi's own RunningStats and transforms
No released checkpoint trained on LIBERO-90 or on exUMI was found; the released LIBERO checkpoints were trained on physical-intelligence/libero
The VLABench fork has no PI05 config, so the released pi05 VLABench checkpoints are provenance only
lerobot/behavior1k-task0045 names no state dims; its layout is inferred from the GR00T modality.json of a sibling BEHAVIOR R1Pro conversion plus a sin/cos structural check
LeRobot 0.4.0 rows for r393 are read with pyarrow and cast to float32 as hf_transform_to_torch does (checked on 4 rows), not through LeRobotDataset.__getitem__ (videos are not downloaded)

finding.message: observation.state dim 117: std 1.16e-12 - near-zero variance amplifies noise after normalization

phase1.label: unresolved
phase1.reason: Pinned source stats report dimension 117 near 1e-12 std, but raw frame distribution and actual normalization behavior were not checked; near constancy alone is not a defect.

assertions.text: The flagged dim has near-zero variance (the board reports std ~1e-12).
assertions.confirm_if: stored meta/stats.json std < 1e-9 AND the sampled raw std < 1e-9 in every sampled file
assertions.refute_if: stored std >= 1e-6 OR pooled sampled std >= 1e-6
assertions.note: the board std is computed by the detector from its own loaded rows (source pin kinema.nan.std_from_loaded_rows); an exact match is not expected

assertions.stage: feature selection and normalization, per configuration and mode
assertions.text: Near-zero variance amplifies noise after normalization.

outcomes.not_consumed: the configuration does not pass the flagged dim to a normalizer
outcomes.nonfinite: any normalized output of the flagged dim, in sample, is NaN/Inf
outcomes.amplified: in-sample normalized std of the flagged dim >= 0.1 (raw variation of ~1e-10 brought to >= 10% of unit scale)
outcomes.not_amplified: finite, and in-sample normalized std of the flagged dim <= 0.01
outcomes.not_reached: construction or loading failed before normalization

assertions.text: Descriptive only: what each executed normalizer outputs if deployment values leave the training range.
assertions.verdict_role: none - synthetic inputs never decide B1 or B2
